entries.title: Psalms 14:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The fool has said in his heart, "[There is] no God." They are corrupt, They have done abominable works, There is none who does good.

entries.title: Psalms 14:2
segments: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there are any who understand, who seek God.

entries.title: Psalms 14:3
segments: They have all turned aside, They have together become corrupt; [There is] none who does good, No, not one.

entries.title: Psalms 14:4
segments: ¶Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, And do not call on the LORD?

entries.title: Psalms 14:5
segments: There they are in great fear, For God [is] with the generation of the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 14:6
segments: You shame the counsel of the poor, But the LORD [is] his refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 14:7
segments: Oh, that the salvation of Israel [would come] out of Zion! When the LORD brings back the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice [and] Israel be glad.
